kResidualAnalysis.explanation: The value 0.901588 represents the normalized linear solver residual (||r_5|| / ||r_0||) of the discrete SST k transport matrix after 5 Gauss-Seidel sweeps per outer SIMPLE iteration. Because the k-equation is weakly diagonally dominant compared to omega (which has strong quadratic destruction beta*omega^2), 5 linear sweeps achieve only a 10% reduction of the linear residual per outer iteration. However, the outer-loop field change of k is small and bounded, and omega converges to 3.33e-4 in the same 5 sweeps.
